title: Fixed-ring valued sheaves and modules over the constant ring on a sieve site
statement:
Fix universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$: its covering sieves contain the maximal sieve and satisfy pullback of sieves and transitivity. A sieve is a collection of arrows into a fixed object closed under precomposition. A presheaf with values in sets, abelian groups, rings or modules is a sheaf when every covering-sieve matching diagram is a limit diagram. No fibre products in $\mathcal C$ are assumed. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $\Lambda^{\mathrm{pre}}$ be the constant ring presheaf with identity restriction maps, and let $\underline\Lambda=(\Lambda^{\mathrm{pre}})^\#$ be its ring sheafification, with unit $\iota:\Lambda^{\mathrm{pre}}\to\underline\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

Let $\operatorname{Sh}_J(\mathcal C,\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda})$ be the category of presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules which are sheaves, with $\Lambda$-linear natural transformations. Let $\operatorname{Mod}_J(\underline\Lambda)$ have as objects abelian sheaves $N$ equipped, at each $C$, with an $\underline\Lambda(C)$-module structure on $N(C)$, compatible with restrictions by $(s x)|_{C'}=s|_{C'}x|_{C'}$; its morphisms are natural transformations linear over $\underline\Lambda(C)$ at each $C$. This is the category of sheaves of $\underline\Lambda$-modules of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

Restriction of scalars along $\iota$ gives an additive equivalence
$$\operatorname{Mod}_J(\underline\Lambda)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}_J(\mathcal C,\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda}).$$
For every fixed-$\Lambda$ module-valued sheaf $N$ there is a unique $\underline\Lambda$ action on its same underlying abelian sheaf extending its original action along $\iota$. Every natural transformation linear for the original fixed-$\Lambda$ actions is linear for these extended actions. This action extension is a quasi-inverse equivalence retaining the underlying abelian sheaves and their maps. There is no nonzero-ring or nonempty-site hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules, is the scalar-extension prototype; this agent-extracted constant-ring equivalence is stated on arbitrary Grothendieck covering-sieve topologies, as required by former step 2 of the dense comparison. Its no-fibre-product scope is supported by the generic GrothendieckTopology constructions in Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Sheafification.lean:54-72,125-150; no claim that the ordinary pretopology statement supplies that scope without this extension.
